# Examples and use cases

Each section is a form pattern you can open in the [FormEngine demo](https://demo.formengine.io/). The screenshot and the demo use the
same form. If the Designer UI is still unfamiliar, start with [The Designer workspace](/meet-the-designer/the-designer-workspace).

## Contact and lead capture

Name, email, a message field, and a submit button. Common for support, sales, and marketing pages.

<img src="/assets/guide/introduction/example-contact-lead.png" alt="Contact us form with name, email, message, and Submit on the canvas." />

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=contact-lead&view=mui'); return false;">Open Contact us in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

Start with [Create your first form](/your-first-form/create-your-first-form) and [Add fields to your form](/your-first-form/add-fields-to-your-form).

## Registration and onboarding

Account details with required fields and email validation before submit.

<img src="/assets/guide/introduction/example-account-registration.png" alt="Create your account form with required Full name and Email fields on the canvas." />

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=account-registration&view=mui'); return false;">Open account registration in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

Follow [Validation on your first form](/your-first-form/add-validation-on-your-first-form) and [Common validation patterns](/behavior-and-validation/common-validation-patterns).

## Surveys and feedback

A short questionnaire with a required choice field, optional comments, and a submit button.

<img src="/assets/guide/introduction/example-feedback-survey.png" alt="Feedback survey with satisfaction choices and optional comments on the canvas." />

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=feedback-survey&view=mui'); return false;">Open Feedback survey in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

See [Choice fields](/fields-and-data/choice-fields) and [Labels and help text](/fields-and-data/labels-and-help-text).

## Multi-step and sectioned layouts

Tabs, wizards, cards, and columns for address blocks, checkouts, or guided processes.

<img src="/assets/guide/structure/tabs-sections-canvas-plain.png" alt="Tabbed multi-section form on the canvas." />

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=employee-onboarding-tabs&view=rsuite-inject-css'); return false;">Open employee onboarding (tabs) in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=checkout-sections&view=mui'); return false;">Open checkout sections in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=shipping-columns&view=mui'); return false;">Open shipping columns in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

See [Form structure and containers](/form-structure-and-layout/form-structure-and-containers), [Tabs and multi-step layouts](/form-structure-and-layout/tabs-and-multi-step-layouts), and [Rows, columns, and grids](/form-structure-and-layout/rows-columns-and-grids).

## Simple data-driven screens

Lists, detail panels, and fields that show or hide when your app supplies data.

<img src="/assets/guide/data-driven/show-hide-canvas-plain.png" alt="Form with conditional fields on the canvas." />

:::tip Try it

<a href="#" onclick="openMinimalWindow('https://demo.formengine.io/?&formName=show-hide-fields&view=mui'); return false;">Open show/hide fields in demo</a> - opens the FormEngine demo in a popup window with the form this article starts from.

:::

Field keys and runtime values are covered in [What is form data?](/fields-and-data/what-is-form-data). See
[Show or hide fields](/simple-data-driven-screens/show-or-hide-fields).
